theme: A light Friday, with the holidays quietly asking for decisions.
greeting: Two morning calls and then the day opens up, Dan. The real tug today is a pair of holiday bookings that have drifted well past their dates.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: On the Mike + Dan board (p1), overdue about six weeks. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — a refundable hold now costs nothing and removes the risk.

needsAttention.title: December break destination still open
needsAttention.detail: On the board (p2); the decide-by (Sep 30) and book-by (Oct 15) dates have both passed. Holiday inventory for six over a three-week window is the thinnest of the year, so every day narrows the options.

flagged.title: KPMG US Managing Director alert
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn job alert worth a glance given the board/exec search.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail promos — Monocle, Harry & David, Hims, Expensify, and the like.

recipe.title: Roasted pumpkin soup
recipe.why: Autumn squash is at its peak, so a slow-roasted pumpkin soup makes the most of the season.
